units.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for Java reads and writes PDF documents, converts PDF to HTML and raster images, and supports basic text extraction and form handling.

It creates new PDF documents and edits existing ones by adding pages with Page, inserting text with TextFragment, and saving the result, as demonstrated by instantiating a Document, adding a page, appending a text fragment, and saving to a PDF file.
It builds interactive forms by adding radio button options to cells within a page, setting option names, and preserving insertion order so options can be accessed sequentially.
It adds and manages annotations by creating widget annotations with a specified rectangle, setting their border and background colors, and reading those color values back.
It renders PDF pages to raster images using device classes such as BmpDevice, GifDevice, JpegDevice, PngDevice, and TiffDevice for multi-page TIFF output.
It extracts plain text from PDF pages per page using TextDevice.
It signs documents with PKCS#7 using PdfSigner, PKCS7, and PKCS7Detached, and verifies existing signatures with SignatureVerificationResult.
It optimizes document size by removing unused objects, linking duplicate streams, recompressing streams, and subsetting images or fonts through Document.optimizeResources().
It converts documents to PDF/A-1 through PDF/A-4 using PdfAValidator, PdfAConverter, and PdfAValidationResult.
This example creates a new PDF document, adds a page, and inserts a widget annotation with a red border, then prints the RGB values of the border color.
The following workflows demonstrate creating a PDF from scratch, adding text, inserting form fields into table cells, and configuring widget annotation appearance.
Add a text fragment and radio button option to a table cell.
Create a new PDF with a text fragment and save it.
Append multiple radio button options to a cell in order.
Set and read the background color of a widget annotation.
Set and inspect the border style of a radio button option.

The central entry point is the Document class, whose pages are accessed through PageCollection and Page, each backed by a Resources dictionary. Convenience operations for editing, extracting, converting, signing, and securing documents are exposed through facades such as PdfFileEditor, PdfContentEditor, PdfBookmarkEditor, PdfExtractor, PdfConverter, and PdfFileSignature.
The org namespace serves as the root package for the Aspose.PDF FOSS for Java library.
The org.aspose namespace contains core classes and facades for working with PDF documents, including Document, PageCollection, Page, and editor classes such as PdfContentEditor and PdfFileSignature.

The org.aspose.pdf namespace holds the primary types for PDF document manipulation, including Document, Page, PageCollection, Resources, and the full set of content, annotation, form, and structure classes defined by ISO 32000-1:2008.
It adds broader format conversion (including OCR and non-PDF output formats), full feature completeness, and commercial support.
LoadFormat enum lists the DocX, HTML, Markdown, PDF, and Xlsx file formats.
DoWhileStmt class holds a do-while loop's test condition, body, and source position via its test, body, and at members.
XfaPacket class represents an XFA packet with a name, document reference, and dirty flag, and provides methods to get its document, name, source bytes, and mark itself dirty.
